The '''Corjain system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="DarkStryder note">Page 5 of ''The DarkStryder Campaign''{{'s}} Adventure Book states that star systems and primary worlds in the Kathol sector share the same name unless otherwise noted.</ref> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corjain]]. It was connected to the [[Kolatill system/Legends|Kolatill]], [[Oon Tien system/Legends|Oon Tien]], and [[Charis system/Legends|Charis systems]] via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="tdc" />
